rationale: The signal does not identify target F, much less establish {a,c} as its unique internal root cause. Even a minimal configuration that reproduced F would establish test-relative reproducibility without establishing a unique causal mechanism. No unresolved empirical relation supplying that causal warrant is stated.

signal_basis.exact_text: The ddmin complement ledger and single-removal exit-bit vector cannot establish target-F sufficiency: the binary channel pools handled deadlines, preflight configuration rejection and harness termination, with either bit value possible both with and without F.
A retained minimal configuration demonstrates reproducibility under the test, not necessarily the unique underlying causal mechanism.
